verdict.rationale: Navan's docs show spend can be queried by department, vendor/merchant, and category via MCP/API, and card transactions (including Navan-issued cards) are retrievable directly rather than waiting for statements, supporting near real-time visibility for founders. Missing for 10: explicit same-day latency claims for card feeds, a dedicated real-time dashboard description, and independent/hands-on corroboration of update speed.
